description: Shared test account's subscription was cancelled by the nightly suite and never restored.
howSeeded: Let the cancellation test run against the shared account without its restore step, then ran the renewal test.
decidingEvidence: The audit log showing the subscription was cancelled by an earlier run, combined with the rule that product-owned rows are TEST_DATA regardless of who staled them.
twinAxis: Both fail on state an earlier run left behind. Here the stale thing is a row the product owns, so ownership sends it to TEST_DATA.
